title: Israel election count leaves neither bloc with a clear majority; final results due by Nov 4
detail: After the Oct 27 vote, exit polls reported by NPR showed an opposition bloc led by Eisenkot at about 52 seats against 50 for Netanyahu's coalition, and Al Jazeera described a race with no outright winner. Partial tallies (i24, still updating) differ between 53 and 56 seats for the coalition, 48 for the opposition and 16-19 for Arab parties; neither bloc reached the 61-seat majority of the 120-seat Knesset in these tallies. Reports indicate final results are due by Nov 4 and that coalition-building depends on whether Arab parties are included. Figures are preliminary and sources disagree.

media.caption: Israel election: high turnout lifts opposition hopes
